address: Via Vigna di Corte 6, Castel Gandolfo, 00073, Italy
bio: A short distance from the striking piazza overlooked by the papal palace, yet occupying a more discreet location, you will find a pleasant and informal dining room, managed by staff both charming and knowledgeable. The dishes are not necessarily rooted in Lazio’s culinary traditions; there are also offerings of varied provenance, occasionally with a more creative flourish.
